body:
Plan, rules and numbers: wf-context/docs-gaps/pass2.md (read "How a section is bound" first). Worktree wf-docs2, branch docs/pass2; DOCS_COMMON.md applies. Per-section list: wf-context/docs-gaps/pass2/out-before/binding-sections.md.

Rules in short: bind claims, not mentions. For each target section, cite the code its claims depend on: `pass2/dsdef.sh <file>#<Symbol> [stable|api]` prints the id (idempotent, writes `//ds:def` in this repo's style), then link the name in the sentence: [`Name`](ds:block?id=<id>). Defaults and limits cite their const. Pitfalls that state library or driver behaviour cite the code (or the test) that makes it true. Snippet-synced Go blocks stay with `task docs:snippets`; bind the prose around them. Only `//ds:def` lines may change in library files. Never run `ds scan`, `ds ack` or `ds refresh` (the coordinator scans and commits `.ds/` once at the end); `ds check` must stay at 0 errors.

Owns: `docs/schedules/`, `docs/events/`, `docs/batches/`; examples: aggregate-digest, batch-completion, batch-durable, batch-lifecycle, batches, change-triggers, cron-builder, cron-schedules, datasets, datasets-shared, debounce, events-more, events-signal, events-webhooks, failover-schedules, latest-only, output-store, schedule-export, schedule-groups, schedule-hooks, schedule-keep-runs, schedule-overlap, schedule-specs, schedule-tools.

Binding now: 26 pages, 198 sections describe library code (Try it and Related excluded), 5 bound.

## Bind (one line per page: target sections, bound now, the unbound ones)

## Gaps to close

- [ ] Cite the uncovered def `mw-filemode-nev3zxnq` (middleware/output.go, `FileMode`) from schedules/output.md.
- [ ] Cite instead of typing: `schedexport.FormatKubernetes`, `FormatLaunchd`, `FormatSystemd`, `FormatTaskScheduler` (export.md); `batch.CallbackKind` and its `Callback*` values (lifecycle.md); `events.ContentTypeCloudEventsJSON` (cloudevents.md); `MisfirePolicy` (misfire.md); `LocalCronOption`, `BackfillOption`: none is named by any page.

## Done when

- [ ] `python3 tools/binding.py` + `tools/batches.py` (see pass2.md) show every target section of this batch bound, or the report names the section and why it states no claim worth binding.
- [ ] `ds check` 0 errors; `task docs:wrap docs:links docs:snippets docs:words` pass; `go test -race` of every example touched.
- [ ] Report wf-context/reports/docs-p2-w4.md with before/after binding counts, defs added (id, file), Shared-file lines, Library bugs, DONE.
